sequential_dependency.intermediate: For each matched marker color, the rotated relative cell offsets (dr, dc) that preserve the complete eight-connected source piece.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Infer the selected quarter-turn setting from the demonstrations and rotate every matched outside-piece relative offset around its unique marker.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Translate those rotated offsets onto the same-colored marker in the cropped canvas and paint each source cell value at its resulting target coordinate.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: Every Step B target is canvas_marker + the Step A offset; substituting the unrotated offsets under quarter_turns=1 changes the painted coordinates and therefore the final grid.
